integrity: A self-contained symbolic proof establishes all quantifiers. Independent finite verification compares every factor to an abbreviated exact test and independently checks pair counts. Finite examples are not substituted for the infinite proof. Special cases t=2 and a=b=1 have prior antecedents; novelty concerns the full all-power family and arbitrary-size attractor certificate. Definitive priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Linear finite words (0^a1^b)^t with integer a,b>=1 and t>=2 only; no other primitive periods, circular factors, or higher alphabets. The four tests are irredundant within their natural set if a,b>=2, not claimed to be a globally smallest certificate over arbitrary factor families.
title: Four-factor certificates and exact optimal-attractor populations for binary two-run powers
